Module com.example.proyectoescriturarapida
Package com.example.proyectoescriturarapida.model

Class Temporizador

java.lang.Object
com.example.proyectoescriturarapida.model.Temporizador
All Implemented Interfaces:
ITemporizador
public class Temporizador extends Object implements ITemporizador
Handles the countdown timer logic for the gameplay. Uses JavaFX Timeline to update the UI label in real-time on the JavaFX Application Thread, eliminating the need for Platform.runLater(). Executes a callback when the countdown reaches zero.

  • Method Details

    • iniciar

      public void iniciar(int segundos)
      Starts or restarts the countdown from the specified number of seconds. Cancels any previously active timeline before creating a new one. Updates the label each second and triggers alTerminar at zero.
      Specified by:
      iniciar in interface ITemporizador
      Parameters:
      segundos - Initial countdown value in seconds.
